notes.title: Release Date Uodated
notes.notes:
Hi guys:
       It's AWE_some_ZT, the developer of <WHAMPUNCH>.
       I'm nervous but still have to say this: <WHAMPUNCH> release date shall be jumped to AUGUST, can't published in April now.
       The reason is I developed this game for 10 months before, as full-time. Now I got myself a new full-time job. So I can get some revenue to keep the development move forward. The work is not easy so the development time will be reduced. 
       In consideration of the quality of this game, I also want to polish it to a more beatiful version. I received many suggestions in the DEMO test duration. I am surprised and inspired. 
       So, I'm working on it. I have to say sorry to my subscribers, but I promise you all I will finish this game ASAP, as a official version(Less Bugs, greater art).
       So, I hope you guys doing well, I'll keep post here, and let's meet in AUGUST!!!!
